PRIMARY_METRIC_FROZEN.name: on-time fraction of eligible offered requests
PRIMARY_METRIC_FROZEN.formula: G_p = (mandatory requests COMPLETED by their d_SLO) / (eligible offered requests)
PRIMARY_METRIC_FROZEN.denominator: eligible offered = non-release requests with deadline <= absolute horizon, computed from the COMMON trace before any policy runs
PRIMARY_METRIC_FROZEN.NOT_a_rate: This is a FRACTION, not per-cycle goodput. It does NOT divide by the measurement duration.
PRIMARY_METRIC_FROZEN.no_switching: goodput, on-time fraction and admitted throughput are NOT interchangeable. Only this formula is used for the primary gate. 'admitted' is an intermediate policy outcome and is NEVER a numerator or denominator.
PRIMARY_METRIC_FROZEN.correction: An earlier statement that 'only the numerator moves' was WRONG. 'admitted' moves across policies too, but 'admitted' is not the numerator. The numerator is on_time; the denominator is the common eligible cohort.

HORIZON_RECONCILED.question: does H_absolute - T_measurement_start == 12000?
HORIZON_RECONCILED.answer: NO, and 12000 was never the sweep's horizon. 12000 is the horizon in tests/test_gm_mutations.py, a different context that was quoted in error.
HORIZON_RECONCILED.horizon_semantics: absolute end cycle; sim.run loops range(horizon), so duration == absolute end
HORIZON_RECONCILED.rule: derived per trace as latest completion deadline plus one declared L_down,max
HORIZON_RECONCILED.requirement_that_binds: identical for every policy on the same trace
HORIZON_RECONCILED.verified: 16 configurations x 9 policies, all identical per configuration
HORIZON_RECONCILED.why_not_a_global_constant: configurations have different arrival spans; a shared constant would censor them unevenly and make the cohorts incomparable

CONTIGUOUS_REGION_DEFINITION.step_1_cell: a CELL is (frames, ws_ratio, nonevict, spec_share, slack, load). Within a cell, aggregate over the 5 frozen seeds FIRST: the cell PASSES iff >= 3 of 5 seeds satisfy every discovery requirement.
CONTIGUOUS_REGION_DEFINITION.step_2_region: a REGION is a maximal set of PASSING cells that are identical on ALL non-load axes and occupy >= 2 ADJACENT values of the predeclared load ordering [0.70, 0.80, 0.90, 0.95].
CONTIGUOUS_REGION_DEFINITION.adjacency: adjacent means consecutive indices in that ordering; 0.70 and 0.90 are NOT adjacent
CONTIGUOUS_REGION_DEFINITION.step_3_forward: EVERY region satisfying step 2 is forwarded to confirmation.
CONTIGUOUS_REGION_DEFINITION.forbidden: selecting a region because it has the largest observed gain, or any other post-hoc criterion
CONTIGUOUS_REGION_DEFINITION.ordering_is_binding: seed aggregation happens BEFORE the adjacency test, never after

RTL_GENERATION_REUSE_ORDERING: 2. invalidate and unpublish the old mapping
INVARIANT: there must be NO cycle in which a replacement is visible carrying the previous generation.
note: generation matching is NOT an eviction condition. It validates descriptor_valid = entry.phys_idx == d.phys_idx && entry.generation == d.expected_generation.

CENSORING_POLICY_INDEPENDENCE.verified_structurally: policies receive req read-only; zero assignments to req fields in any of the 9 policies and none in sim.run
CENSORING_POLICY_INDEPENDENCE.verified_per_configuration: the auditor now requires offered, censored, horizon and an eligible-cohort hash to be identical across all 9 policies in EVERY configuration, not on one sample trace
CENSORING_POLICY_INDEPENDENCE.limitation: this run's records may not carry an eligible_hash field; where absent the auditor falls back to offered/censored/horizon and says so. The confirmatory run must emit the hash.

PROVENANCE_LIMITATION: A local plan plus a detached local hash fixes the BYTES but does not independently prove WHEN it was created. This is a PRE-UNBLINDING PROCEDURAL FREEZE, not a cryptographically timestamped one. It is not externally timestamped and not in a witnessed append-only record.
